svg.desc: A pipeline: the corpus, embedded offline, feeds stage 1, BM25 plus a dense bi-encoder fused by reciprocal rank fusion, which returns the top 50; stage 2, a cross-encoder, scores each query-document pair and returns the top 5 to the user or an LLM.
